topic: Deep Learning with TensorFlow and Keras
learningObjectives: Understand the basic workflow of building a neural network with Keras.
Identify layers, activation functions, loss functions, and optimizers.
Trace the training process of a neural network.

activities.title: Keras Model Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore each component of a neural network and its purpose.

content.concept: A Keras model is composed of layers that transform inputs into predictions, with activation functions controlling nonlinear transformations.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Receives the input features supplied to the neural network.
A fully connected layer that transforms inputs using learned weights and biases.
Applies a nonlinear transformation to help the network learn complex patterns.
Produces the final prediction or output of the network.
Represents the complete collection of configured layers used for training and prediction.

activities.title: Build a Neural Network
activities.instruction: Assemble the components of a simple Keras neural network.

content.concept: Neural networks are built by connecting layers that progressively transform input representations into useful outputs.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Training Configuration
activities.instruction: Identify the role of each component used to configure model training.

content.concept: Layers define the model structure, activation functions transform values, loss functions measure prediction error, optimizers update parameters, and metrics track performance.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Layer → Defines how information is transformed
Activation Function → Adds a nonlinear transformation
Optimizer → Updates model parameters to reduce loss
Metric → Tracks a chosen measure of model performance

activities.title: Training Loop
activities.instruction: Arrange the stages of a neural network training cycle.

content.concept: Training repeatedly performs forward passes, calculates loss, computes gradients, updates parameters, and repeats across batches and epochs.
